title: Normalize positive resonant Yukawa event shell network against exact continuum and restore soft-φ phase space
objective: The new exact-resonant toy χ1↔χ2+φ event graph is on shell, positive, entropy-consistent, and has only three physical linear invariants. But all phase capacities and rates are illustrative and its Eφ,min=0.048 GeV misses physically allowed soft 86-eV daughters. Develop a positive microscopic Lorentz-invariant rate assignment to shared resonant shell cells/nodes, with physical p²dp and spin degeneracy. Recover the mapped boosted-log-Eφ continuum weak source and physical energy moment before invoking any time solution. If strict energy lattice cannot cover eV IR without spurious invariants or unmanageable resolution, document a constructive limitation and investigate adaptive resonant/cut-cell network or constrained energy-resolving entropy closure.

Retain original mφ=86e−9 GeV and true pmax2/8/16 physical mapped weak rates; never treat toy Eφmin=.048 GeV as IR-resolved.
